title: Challenges in the simulation of enzymatic transition states with emerging multireference character
summary: Highly successful drugs, such as transition-state inhibitors, were designed by mimicking the precise geometry of enzymatic transition states, a strategy that requires quantum chemistry accurate enough to specify molecular structure at sub-Å resolution. A central challenge during such a quantum chemistry simulation is that classical single-reference method can deviate substantially from the exact energy at strongly correlated transition states.
